The Department of Student Housing builds, maintains and operates facilities that promote and support a learning-centered and resident-focused organization. Under general supervision, the incumbent provide the first point of entry for all individuals entering or contacting the Operations Service Center to address a variety of questions, concerns, or issues. Under the general supervision of the Associate Director Facility Services, the incumbent serves as a primary administrative staff member supporting the Facilities Operations and Capital Planning unit of Student Housing. The incumbent will supervise 10-15 student staff (Student Office Assistants) who provide administrative support for the Operations Service Center staff. The incumbent will maintain and upgrade office equipment and interface with residents, appropriate vendors, campus departments, and provide management support for 13 professional staff. This position also provides significant other duties including maintaining office supply inventory, answering phones, and completing special projects as needed.

The incumbent is required to use effective problem-solving, decision-making, and interpersonal communication skills in the discharge of their duties. Must be able to respond to changing priorities while working in a dynamic environment. Ability to work collaboratively and independently on multiple projects, set priorities and organize tasks.
Available for occasional overtime and weekend work. Department can require overtime work to meet operational needs.
Must be able to pass background check.
Must be willing and able to assist in the event of a disaster.

Demonstrated ability courteously, effectively, diplomatically, and professionally.

Demonstrate understanding of the needs and issues of a highly diverse clientele.
Ability to follow, model and promote conduct that adheres to the University Of California Principles Of Community.

Critical thinking skills to evaluate information and make decisions about the correct course of action.
